verdict_rationale: The AINGL fabric (ToolRunner.js + pilotApi.invokeTool + handlers.real.ts with 53 live handlers) is structurally real and is used by other surfaces (PropertyForge, TerraPilot, PropertyTreasury, SalesComparison). However, DefensePacket.tsx — the UI for 'Generate Defense Packet' — bypasses the fabric entirely via 3 direct fetch() calls to /api/dais/defense-narrative, /api/dossier/documents, and /api/dossier/packets. The real handler assemble_boe_packet exists in handlers.real.ts and maps to the correct backend endpoint, but is not wired to the UI entrypoint. ToolRunner gate enforcement (Gates 4/5/6), governance policy application, and trace event emission are all absent on this action's execution path.
gap_classification: Handler exists in fabric, UI entrypoint not wired to it. Route: DefensePacket.tsx should call pilotApi.invokeTool({ toolId: 'assemble_boe_packet', ... }) instead of direct fetch().
next_action_required: Wire DefensePacket.tsx to use pilotApi.invokeTool('assemble_boe_packet') and pilotApi.invokeTool('summarize_dossier') so gate enforcement and trace events apply to this action path.
